thread:
alex: FYI the JS SDK 2.0.0 release is causing onboarding failures. Node apps hit `Cannot find module '@redwood/inference/dist/index.cjs'` even though the tarball only has `.mjs` files.

mira: Ouch. Which artifacts did the publish include?

alex: `npm pack` output from the published package: `package/README.md, package/dist/index.mjs, package/dist/index.mjs.map, package/package.json`. No node build, no types.

pkg-bot: Packaging job: https://ci.example.com/jobs/2991. The build writes node artifacts to `dist/node` and edge artifacts to `dist/edge`. The publish step uses `files: ["dist/**", "README.md"]` but there's an accidental `.npmignore` entry excluding `dist/node/*` created in an old cleanup PR.

mira: So we shipped only the edge bundle. That explains Vercel previews working while Node quickstarts break. Also saw Sentry reports with `.cjs.map` referenced but missing.

yusuf: Any quick mitigations?

alex: Short term we can republish a 2.0.1 that includes node artifacts and moves types into `dist/types`. Longer term we should standardize the layout to `dist/node`, `dist/edge`, `dist/types` and keep `exports` explicit.

triage: Suggested actions: 1) rebuild with tsup formats `["cjs","esm"]` for node/edge builds and enable dts output to `dist/types`; 2) remove the exclude in `.npmignore` and update `files` in package.json accordingly; 3) add a CI pack-check step that runs `npm pack` + `tar -tf` and then runs node require + esm import + `tsc --noEmit` smoke tests against the tarball.

mira: Also check the `exports` mapping — currently it points `require` -> `dist/index.cjs` and `import` -> `dist/index.mjs`. With the new layout we should map `require` -> `./dist/node/index.cjs` and `import` -> `./dist/edge/index.mjs` to avoid ambiguity.

yusuf: Noted another subtle bug: the retry logic behaves differently between edge and node bundles in auth failures. We should add a unit that verifies identical retry predicates across builds.

alex: Good catch. I'll cut the hotfix publish (2.0.1-rc), run local `npm pack` and smoke tests, then publish stable. I'll also update quickstart to prefer `import` but include a `require()` fallback snippet for Node users.

pkg-bot: Local `npm pack` for 2.0.1-rc shows: `package/dist/node/index.cjs, package/dist/node/index.cjs.map, package/dist/edge/index.mjs, package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map, package/dist/types/index.d.ts, package/package.json`. Smoke tests: node require/import ✅, ESM import ✅, tsc typecheck ✅.

mira: Thanks. Follow-ups: open an RFC for publish layout, add pack-check to CI, and add a release checklist item: "verify artifact matrix (.cjs, .mjs, .d.ts) and exports consistency."

yusuf: I'll take the retry predicate tests. Assigning SDK-301.

alex: Republished 2.0.1 stable. Support notified and onboarding docs updated. Closing thread after RFC merged.

triage: Closing once CI PR lands.
